checks.check: no ground truth columns in transaction input
refund positive and bounded by original
transfer pairs same date and net zero
active recurring series has next date
every UTC/local month boundary case is labelled
recurring skip series labels match manifest
budget mismatch labels match manifest impact
inactive budget categories are fully labelled
checks.note: Intentional taxonomy mismatch cases are labelled in budget_labels.csv.

checks.check: refund ground truth has positive amounts
no duplicate lifecycle event types per entity
ledger total equals sum of account balances
monthly spend reconciles to categorized ledger
recurring insights reconcile to detected series

notes: The pipeline never reads ground_truth/. It is joined only in this evaluation step.
Strict net spend excludes transfers, offsets refunds, and assigns periods from local transaction dates.
Naive overstatement is a diagnostic: both transfer legs and refunds are treated as new spending.
Recurring detection uses monthly gap and amount stability; labels are generated independently from the detector.
Budget resolution maps deprecated taxonomy codes through category_alias before comparison.
A boundary-case row that also carries a primary refund/transfer anomaly keeps that primary transaction label; all boundary rows still have ground-truth labels.

anomalies.behavior: UTC posted_at month differs from the local transaction month.
anomalies.resolution: Assign budget and insight periods from the local transaction date, not raw UTC.

anomalies.behavior: 2376 budget rows use deprecated category codes.
anomalies.resolution: Map deprecated codes through category_alias before comparing actuals.

anomalies.behavior: Positive refund credit resembles a purchase descriptor and lacks a refund link.
anomalies.resolution: Treat positive credits in expense categories as refunds and offset the original category.

anomalies.behavior: Unlinked duplicate of an internal transfer debit appears as spending.
anomalies.resolution: Exclude internal transfer legs and linked duplicates from spend and budget actuals.
Use gap detection and report the missing occurrence; do not silently shift the series.
